title: Early on, the wood north of Last Light (Split Oak / Charcoal Ring / Antler Stake / etc.) and later the Hollowbrook downs have many similarly-described, unlabeled-on-entry nodes, so finding a specific target (the sunken shrine, the king's causeway) meant blind wandering in a direction until the room text finally named it, rather than the exits themselves hinting at what lay that way.
